name: Wyoming State Cross Country Championships
where: Cheyenne, WY · Little America Golf Course
headline: Wyoming state: Racines ends Madsen's three-peat bid
summary: Cheyenne Central senior Adalyn Racines won the 4A girls title in 17:34.5, ending Cheyenne East's Maggie Madsen's bid for a third straight title; Madsen was second in 17:54.8, and both ran well under the 18:17.63 course record Madsen set last year. Big Horn's Lyla Marney won her third straight 2A girls title in 18:41.3, nearly two minutes clear, while Powell's Karee Cooley (3A girls, 18:53.4) and Burlington's Kellen Winters (2A boys, 16:20.5) repeated. Sheridan's Eli Balkenbush won 4A boys in 15:23.9 and Mountain View's Colt Madsen won 3A boys in 16:13.0.
